Hi Amit — thanks for the questions, good callouts. Technical notes below to address each point: 

1) PHI & ingestion options
- If dataset will contain any free-text that could include PHI, we recommend the Redwood Private deployment (VPC) for ingestion + evaluation. For quick iteration you can also redact identifiers and send a de-identified CSV to our hosted pipeline.
- In either case, use the attached CSV schema: columns = [patient_hash, encounter_id, triage_text, labels (pipe-separated), clinician_rationale]. Include a sample row in the first 10 rows for sanity checks.

2) Latency profile
- redwood-llm-3b-rev1: ~220–350ms p95 @ 128 tokens (gpu T4 equivalent), throughput ~45 reqs/s per GPU with continuous batching.
- redwood-llm-3-8b-quant: ~320–600ms p95 @ 128 tokens depending on peak load; quantization saves ~40% cost per token.
- We'll provision a canary instance for your pilot to validate p95 under your load.

3) Scoring support (mixed discrete + generative)
- Yes — our eval runner supports hybrid scoring: discrete labels use F1 / micro / macro; free-text rationale uses a scorer pipeline (ROUGE-L + semantic similarity with an embedding-based ranker). We also support human-in-the-loop adjudication via scorer_guide_v1.pdf.

Prompt examples (suggested)
- Classification prompt (few-shot):
  "Given the triage note, assign categories: [Urgent|Non-urgent|Follow-up]
   Example 1: [note] -> Urgent
   Example 2: [note] -> Follow-up
   Label:"
- Rationale prompt (free-text):
  "In one sentence, explain why the above category applies. Example: 'Active chest pain with hypotension suggests immediate ED referral.'
"
Scoring thresholds (initial draft)
- Classification: min acceptable micro-F1 = 0.82
- Rationale: mean semantic similarity >= 0.72 OR human-agreed pass rate >= 85%

Ingestion path details
- Secure S3 direct upload (presigned URLs) to a sandbox bucket we create for you (preferred for hosted). For VPC, our ingestion agent will pull from your internal S3.
- File naming: summitcare_yyyyMMDD_sample.csv.

I'll add a short prompt bank sampes file to the Drive folder this afternoon. If you'd like, we can run an initial baseline with 300 rows and share the dashboard within 48 hours of ingestion.
